description: Update Brand Runtime through the active host while preserving every Brand Pack and client-owned rule.

pre_conditions.check: The user explicitly requested a Brand Runtime update or asked for update instructions
The active host is known from the current session context

steps.name: Confirm update target
steps.description: Confirm that the request targets Brand Runtime rather than a Brand Pack. Do not load or mutate Brand Pack files for this workflow.

steps.name: Resolve host
steps.description: Resolve Claude Code or Codex from the current session context. Do not infer the host from executable presence when both are installed.

steps.name: Refresh and update
steps.description: When execution was requested, run the host-specific marketplace refresh and plugin update commands in order with normal approval. When instructions only were requested, show the commands without executing.

steps.name: Verify installation
steps.description: Run the host-specific plugin listing command and report the installed Brand Runtime version.

steps.name: Handoff reload
steps.description: Tell the user to run /reload-plugins in Claude Code or start a new session/thread. Never claim the current session loaded the updated plugin before reload.

post_conditions.check: The installed Brand Runtime version was verified or the exact update commands were provided
No Brand Pack, saved brand path, client rule, feedback reference, or plugin cache was edited manually
The user received the correct reload boundary for the active host
